task.description: Write test/specs/REQ-022.md and ExUnit tests under test/letflow/ for Letflow.TenantProvisioning, covering all 4 acceptance criteria. Use test/support/req022_migration_fixture.ex (already provided by ELIXIR-DEV per the design's own recommendation) as the tenant-scoped migration fixture for AC3. REVIEWER's Step 2d review flagged one non-blocking gap worth considering: tenant_scoped_migrations/0's two-part contract (guard pattern + list membership) is enforced only by convention, not a test -- consider a guard test if it fits naturally, but this is not itself a new acceptance criterion, don't treat it as blocking.
acceptance_criteria: priv/repo/migrations gains a tenant_schemas migration (public/default schema) that applies cleanly via mix ecto.migrate, with columns for at minimum tenant_id and schema_name
a provision_tenant_schema/1-equivalent function exists that issues a real CREATE SCHEMA and records the mapping in tenant_schemas, demonstrated against at least one non-default tenant schema name

a migration-replay function exists that re-applies priv/repo/migrations/ against a specific tenant schema via Ecto's prefix: option, demonstrated by confirming at least one table exists under the provisioned schema's own information_schema, not just under public

the moduledoc/description explicitly states, as an open question rather than a silent decision, whether REQ-015's users/groups/tenant_role migrations are retrofitted to use :prefix now or remain in public schema

result.summary: Wrote test/specs/REQ-022.md and test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs covering all 4 acceptance criteria plus schema_name_for_tenant/1 (pure-function) and the tenant-scoped migration guard pattern REVIEWER's Step 2d non-blocking note flagged. 14 tests total (2 describe blocks: schema_name_for_tenant/1 x2, tenant_schemas migration/Registration changeset x5 (AC1), provision_tenant_schema/1 x4 (AC2), replay_migrations/2 unprovisioned x1 + successful-replay x1 (AC3), guard-pattern x1). AC4 (moduledoc open-question content) verified by direct inspection of lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex lines 27-50 (confirmed the 'Open question (REQ-022 acceptance criterion 4 -- not resolved here)' heading and the required substance are present verbatim), not a runtime test -- matches test/specs/REQ-020.md's AC5 precedent and WF-02 Step 3's own explicit warning against manufactured-busywork grep-assertions. Sandbox-incompatibility investigation (design doc SS6's flagged, unresolved TEST-DESIGNER concern): empirically reproduced Ecto.Migrator failing under a plain DataCase sandboxed checkout first (DBConnection.ConnectionError, reason: :queue_timeout, 'could not checkout the connection... connection not available'), root-caused via deps/ecto_sql source (Postgres adapter's default :table_lock migration_lock strategy genuinely needs a second connection DataCase's single-owned sandboxed pool can't supply), then fixed by switching Letflow.Repo to Sandbox :auto mode for just the two Migrator-touching describe blocks (replay_migrations/2's successful-replay block, and the guard-pattern block), with on_exit/1 cleanup (DROP SCHEMA ... CASCADE, row deletes, schema_migrations bookkeeping-row delete by a deliberately implausible 999_999_999 version) since those specific tests are NOT protected by DataCase's normal transaction rollback. Verified this doesn't corrupt other concurrently running async tests' connections by reading Elixir's own installed ex_unit/lib/ex_unit/runner.ex directly (async_loop/4): ExUnit fully drains all async: true modules before starting any async: false module and runs sync modules strictly one at a time -- confirmed this file's required async: false (module-wide, ExUnit has no per-test async setting) has no other test file's connection to disturb when the :auto-mode switch runs. Two other invariants empirically mutation-tested per this project's REQ-020 precedent (not just asserted): (1) AC2 atomicity/rollback -- temporarily moved CREATE SCHEMA outside provision_tenant_schema/1's Repo.transaction/1 (the exact bug class the invariant guards against); the 'leaves no orphan schema or row behind' test failed exactly as expected (13/14 passed, only that test failing: 'Expected false or nil, got true'), no other test changed status; reverted, confirmed clean via git diff --stat, re-ran 14/14 passed. (2) Guard-pattern test -- temporarily removed the `if prefix() do...end` guard from test/support/req022_migration_fixture.ex; the guard-pattern test failed exactly as expected (13/14 passed), no other test changed status; reverted, confirmed clean via git diff --stat, re-ran 14/14 passed. Verified cleanup leaves no residue: ran the file twice consecutively (14 passed both times), then queried the real test DB directly via docker exec psql -- zero tenant_* schemas in pg_catalog.pg_namespace, zero rows in public.tenant_schemas, zero req022-slugged rows in public.tenants, zero schema_migrations row for version 999999999. mix format --check-formatted: exit 0. mix compile --warnings-as-errors: exit 0. Full suite (mix test, not just the new file): baseline before this work was 132 passed (4 properties, 128 tests); after adding this file, 146 passed (4 properties, 142 tests) -- exactly +14, no regressions, no failures anywhere else in the suite.
